rows.details: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR), Bengaluru
"Silk based materials/devices for prognosis and diagnosis of type 3 Diabetes Mellitus, Alzheimer's disease and their pathological nexus"
New Chemistry Unit, JNCASR, Jakkur, Bengaluru

content_sections.heading: About the Centre and the Project
content_sections.text: The Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research is located at Jakkur P.O., Bengaluru - 560064, Karnataka. It describes itself as an autonomous institution under the Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and an Institution Deemed-to-be-University.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: PhD in Chemistry or Life Sciences with good research experience and publication record. Desirable Qualification: PhD in Chemistry or Life Sciences with Chemical Biology, Biomaterials or Biomedical Sciences research experience to work in the above-mentioned project. Candidates with research experience closely related to the project theme [Diabetes, neurodegenerative (Alzheimer's) disease, biomedical research] are encouraged to apply. Age Limit: The maximum age limit is 35 years. The notice does not print an "as on" date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNCASR Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Get the Application form in Template, which the notice says is available on the website. Fill in the application form completely. Attach copies of original testimonials in support of educational qualification, age, experience, publication, etc. Attach a brief resume. Send the application by email to [email protected] latest by 13 November 2026. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview. Candidates will be selected based on their performance in the interview by a selection committee. The interview date is not specified in the notice.
